sentences.text: Present: M/s Y.P. Sood and Praveen Chauhan, Advocates, for the petitioner.
Mr. Rajat Chauhan, Assistant Advocate General, for the respondent-State.
Mr. Kartik Kumar, Advocate, for the of complainant.

After making his submissions for some time in the application, learned Counsel for the applicant/petitioner submits that in case this Court allows the petitioner to move an application before the learned Court below for preponement of the case and learned Counsel appearing for the respondent/complainant gives an undertaking to appear before the learned Trial Court in the matter, the application shall not be pressed at this stage.
Learned Counsel appearing for the non-applicant/complainant submits that the complainant shall put in appearance through Counsel before the learned Trial Court.

In light of respective contentions of the parties, this Court directs that let the matter in FIR No.36 of 2022, dated 10.05.2022, registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code be taken up by the Court on 12.03.2026, on which date the complainant shall appear before the Court through Counsel and thereafter, the Court will proceed in the matter in accordance with law.
The application, therefore, stands disposed of as not pressed.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner shall be at liberty to move an appropriate application before the learned Court below for listing of the .
case on the said date on the strength of the order passed by the Court today.
This application is disposed of with the direction of that let the applicant shall file translated copy of Annexure A-3 within a period of one week from today.
